column1: # A homograph's default reading comes from the schwa dictionary. A rule here
# fires only when one of its trigger words appears within WINDOW words in the
# same sentence, and then selects the OTHER reading.
# Every reading below is verified against the Indonesian entry on
# en.wiktionary.org, which marks the pepet vowel: "ê" is /ə/, "é" and "è" are
# not. See data/homographs-verified.tsv for that audit. The trigger lists are
# ordinary collocations, not dictionary data, and are the part a speaker
# A word with no trigger nearby keeps its dictionary reading, so a missing
# trigger costs nothing and a wrong trigger costs a mispronunciation.
